A few things to know

Can I use ODIQ in Dhivehi?

Yes. The app and this website support English and Dhivehi. Change the language using the language button.

How are payments confirmed?

Transfer to the bank account shown by the boat and upload the slip. The owner checks the transfer and updates the payment status. Uploading a slip alone does not mark an invoice paid.

Is the boat location live tracking?

The displayed location is the latest location shared by the boat owner. Check its update time. It is not continuous tracking or a navigation service.

Can I manage my account and data?

Account controls and the account help page explain account removal, restoration and deletion requests. The Privacy Policy explains record retention.

ODIQ · Information & support

Privacy Policy

Your information, the records you share and the choices available to you.

Last updated: 22 November 2026

Who this policy coversInformation used in the serviceWhy the information is usedWho can see recordsLocation, photos and third-party servicesLocal storage and securityRetention, removal and deletionYour choices and contactContact

Who this policy covers

This policy explains how ODIQ handles information used by boat owners, customers and agents. Boat owners also hold their own customer and transaction records and are responsible for how they use them.

Information used in the service

Depending on your use, records can include your name, phone number, island, account role, boat details and photo; trips, cargo descriptions, quantities and photos; bookings, shop orders, invoices, expenses, supplier details, bank account details, transfer references and uploaded slips. Account passwords are handled by our authentication service. Do not upload bank passwords, PINs or card security codes.

Why the information is used

Information supports sign-in, account access, boat directories, trip and cargo management, bookings, orders, invoices, payment verification, subscriptions and relevant in-app notifications. Names and phone numbers entered by a boat owner may form part of a transaction even before that customer registers. Historical records may be linked to a matching account number under the app’s access rules.

Who can see records

Boat owners see records for their boat. Customers see records made available to their own account and saved boats. Agents receive the island and task access granted by the owner. Authorised developers can manage accounts, subscriptions and support requests in the backend. Boat directory names, contact details, shared status, photos and locations may be visible to app users. ODIQ does not sell personal information.

Location, photos and third-party services

If you choose to share a boat location, the app requests device location access and stores the shared location and update time. Camera and photo access are used when you choose an upload. Service providers support account sign-in and access to your records. Weather requests use the app’s weather providers; opening Google Maps sends you to Google’s service. Those providers may process network and device information under their own policies.

Local storage and security

The app uses local storage for sign-in persistence, language, drafts and notification preferences. Records are protected by account access controls. Shared devices should be signed out when you finish. No online system can guarantee absolute security; contact support if you believe an account or record has been accessed incorrectly.

Retention, removal and deletion

Removing a saved boat does not delete its transaction records. Deactivation preserves an account and its records for possible restoration and is not permanent deletion. A permanent deletion request is a separate action. Personal information not required for legal obligations or existing transaction disputes should be removed or anonymised when deletion is completed. Records that must be retained are restricted to authorised access; permanent deletion does not promise restoration of all data. See Account & deletion help for the available controls.

Your choices and contact

You can update profile details, manage saved boats, change device permissions and clear notifications. Use the account controls to manage removal or request permanent deletion. For access, correction, privacy questions or help when you cannot sign in, use the contact details below. You may be asked to verify account ownership before private information is disclosed or changed.

Contact ODIQ

Terms of Service

Please read these terms before using ODIQ.

Last updated: 22 November 2026

Using ODIQBoat owners, customers and agentsBookings, orders and paymentsSubscriptions and accessAcceptable use and uploadsAvailability and operational informationAccount removal and record retentionChanges and questionsContact

Using ODIQ

ODIQ provides software for boat trips, cargo, bookings, orders, invoices and related records. By using it, you agree to these terms. Provide accurate details and only create or manage accounts you are authorised to use. Protect your password and do not share access with unauthorised people.

Boat owners, customers and agents

Owners are responsible for their boat operations, schedules, capacity, prices, customer records and agent permissions. Customers must provide correct recipient, item and booking details. Agents act within the access assigned by the boat owner and must have permission to enter a customer’s information. Developer verification indicates a review of specified profile details; it is not a guarantee of safety, delivery or financial performance.

Bookings, orders and payments

Transport and product transactions are between the customer and the relevant boat operator. Confirm routes, availability, delivery arrangements, cancellations and refunds with that operator. Verify the bank details shown before transferring. A submitted slip is evidence for review, not confirmation that funds have been received. ODIQ does not guarantee or reverse a bank transfer.

Subscriptions and access

New owner accounts have a two-day trial under the app’s eligibility rules. After access expires, a verified subscription is required for owner business features. Current monthly and yearly prices, availability and bank details are shown in the app. Review them before paying. Renewal is confirmed after developer review. Removing an account does not itself refund a subscription or a boat transaction. Contact support about payment errors or refund requests.

Acceptable use and uploads

Do not impersonate others, submit false slips, access another person’s records, upload unlawful content or interfere with the service. Upload only information and photos you have permission to share. You remain responsible for your content. We may restrict misuse or unauthorised access while investigating.

Availability and operational information

Internet, device or service-provider failures may delay updates. Schedules and availability may change. Locations are the latest shared update, not a continuous tracking service. Weather and Nakaiy information is informational and must not replace official marine warnings or the skipper’s judgement. ODIQ is not an emergency or navigation service.

Account removal and record retention

Deactivation and permanent deletion have different effects, explained in the Privacy Policy and account controls. Deactivation preserves records for a possible return. Permanent deletion removes or anonymises personal data not required to be retained; it does not guarantee full restoration after re-registration. Existing invoices, amounts owed or disputes do not disappear merely because an account is removed.

Changes and questions

Features and terms may be updated. The current version and update date are published on this website. Nothing here excludes rights that cannot lawfully be excluded. Contact ODIQ support for software issues and the relevant boat for transport, goods, ticket or delivery disputes.

Account & deletion help

Clear choices for your account and your records.

Deactivate & keep records

Use this if you want to stop using the account but return later. Deactivation preserves the account and its records. Restore access by signing in with the same account credentials. A deactivated account is not permanently deleted.

Download ODIQ

Request permanent deletion

This is separate from deactivation. Start the request from account controls while signed in. We may ask you to confirm ownership. Personal data that is not required to be retained is removed or anonymised when the request is completed. Returning later does not restore permanently deleted data.

Download ODIQ

What happens to boat records?

Removing a boat from My boats hides its information from your customer view; it does not cancel an order, erase an invoice or delete the boat owner’s records. Deactivation keeps records for restoration. Permanent deletion is handled separately, including any retention needed for legal obligations and existing transaction disputes.

Cannot sign in?

Contact support below with your account phone number and whether you are a boat owner or customer. Never send your password, bank PIN or one-time codes. Support must verify ownership before changing account access.
